shortDescription: Manage an external Hyperledger Fabric peer

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the external peer. Only required when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: peer
options.description: The definition of the external peer Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - A peer matching the specified name will be stopped and removed. C(present) - Asserts that a peer matching the specified name and configuration exists. If no peer matches the specified name, a peer will be created. If a peer matches the specified name but the configuration does not match, then the peer will be updated, if it can be. If it cannot be updated, it will be removed and re-created with the specified configuration.
